post.description:

post.description:
To collect a whole table for a state: e.g. CAINC1 line 3 (per capita personal income) for every Montana county, all years; or CAINC5N earnings by industry for every county, latest year. Follow next_cursor until it is null.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page. Opaque; pins table, state, line_code, years, the county list and the publication_id.

line_code.description: One line code (statistic) of the table, e.g. 3 for CAINC1 per capita personal income. Omit for every line of the table. Pattern: ^[0-9]{1,4}$.

state.description: State as a USPS code (MT), a 2-digit state FIPS (30) or BEA's 5-digit state key (30000); US for the United States total plus the eight BEA regions. The 50 states and DC are supported (BEA county tables carry no territories).

table.description:
BEA Regional county table name (see source_status).

Provider reference: allowed values ["CAINC1", "CAINC4", "CAINC5N", "CAINC6N", "CAINC30", "CAINC91", "CAGDP1", "CAGDP2", "CAGDP8", "CAGDP9", "CAGDP11"].

years.description: ALL (default), LAST5 / LAST10 (newest n years the table serves), one year (2024) or a comma list (2022,2023,2024). Pattern: ^(ALL|all|LAST[1-9][0-9]?|last[1-9][0-9]?|[12][0-9]{3}(,[12][0-9]{3})*)$.

200.description:
Full current list of one BEA county table for one state (or the United States and its eight BEA regions with state US), paginated with a cursor pinned to the table's publication_id. Page 1 fetches the state total row(s) and the state's county list, then the first chunk of counties; each later page fetches one chunk. Segment key: (table, state, line_code, years). Every page re-reads the 'Last updated' note and fails with invalid_input code publication_changed when it differs from the pinned vintage, so two vintages are never mixed. With line_code the page holds one statistic; without it every line of the table. years accepts ALL, LAST<n> (resolved against the table's year list), one year or a comma list. Values keep BEA's flags ((D) suppressed, (NA) not available, (NM), (L), (T)) in data_value with value null.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `records` as the primary payload key.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `code` | string | <TableName>-<LineCode>, the Data API series code. |
| `data_value` | string | As published, thousands separators removed: a number, a flag such as (D) or (NA), or empty. |
| `flag` | string | BEA's non-numeric marker when present: (D), (NA), (NM), (L), (T). |
| `geo_fips` | string |  |
| `geo_name` | string |  |
| `line_code` | string |  |
| `line_description` | string |  |
| `note_refs` | string[] | Footnote marks attached to the line description; see notes. |
| `publication_id` | string |  |
| `retrieved_at` | string |  |
| `source_record_id` | string | bea:<TableName>-<LineCode>:<GeoFips>:<Year> |
| `source_url` | string |  |
| `table` | string |  |
| `time_period` | string |  |
| `unit` | string | Unit as BEA states it in the line description or table subtitle, e.g. thousands of dollars, persons, dollars. |
| `value` | number | data_value parsed as a number in the stated unit; null for flags and blanks. |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.

post.description:
Before a full records_list sweep, to learn whether a table has a new vintage (BEA releases county personal income and GDP once a year, with revisions landing in place), what the latest data year is, and which line codes a table offers.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

table.description:
BEA Regional county table name. CAINC1 personal income summary (lines 1 personal income, 2 population, 3 per capita personal income); CAINC4 income by major component; CAINC5N earnings by NAICS industry; CAINC6N compensation by industry; CAINC30 economic profile (total employment incl. proprietors); CAINC91 gross flow of earnings; CAGDP1 GDP summary; CAGDP2 GDP by industry (current dollars); CAGDP8 chain-type quantity indexes; CAGDP9 real GDP by industry; CAGDP11 contributions to percent change in real GDP.

Provider reference: allowed values ["CAINC1", "CAINC4", "CAINC5N", "CAINC6N", "CAINC30", "CAINC91", "CAGDP1", "CAGDP2", "CAGDP8", "CAGDP9", "CAGDP11"].

200.description:
Cheap version check for one BEA county table: the current vintage (publication_id = <TableName>:<last updated date>, from the table's 'Last updated' note), the latest and first data year, the list of years and line codes the table serves, and a SHA-256 over the canonical United States (GeoFips 00000) records as a drift signal. One request (the national rows, all years). No file URL or publisher hash exists: the data is only served through the interactive backend.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `first_year` | string |  |
| `last_updated` | string |  |
| `last_updated_note` | string | The full 'Last updated: ...' note, e.g. which years are new and which are revised. |
| `latest_year` | string |  |
| `line_codes` | object[] | Line codes (statistics) the table offers, in table order. |
| `national_record_count` | number | Number of United States (GeoFips 00000) records across all lines and years, as fetched for the hash. |
| `national_records_sha256` | string | SHA-256 over the canonical national records (code\|geo_fips\|time_period\|data_value, one per line, newline-terminated). Changes when BEA revises or extends the table. |
| `observed_at_ms` | number |  |
| `publication_id` | string | <TableName>:<YYYY-MM-DD of the 'Last updated' note>; the version every record and cursor is pinned to. |
| `retrieved_at` | string |  |
| `source_url` | string |  |
| `table` | string |  |
| `table_id` | number | iTable TableId behind the table name (CAINC1 = 20, CAGDP2 = 501, ...). |
| `title` | string | Table title as published (footnote marks stripped). |
| `years` | string[] | Every data year the table serves, newest first. |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.
